snapshot: SELECT r.id::bigint AS recording,r.channel_id::bigint AS channel,r.start_time,r.end_time,r.task_id,CASE WHEN octet_length(r.custom_properties::text)<=8192 THEN r.custom_properties ELSE NULL END AS properties,(r.custom_properties IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(r.custom_properties::text)<=8192) AS properties_supported,c.uuid AS channel_uuid,CASE WHEN octet_length(c.name)<=255 THEN c.name ELSE NULL END AS channel_name,c.epg_data_id::bigint AS epg_data_id,(c.stream_profile_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dispatcharr_channels_channeloverride o WHERE o.channel_id=c.id)) AS profile_supported,CASE WHEN octet_length(s.value::text)<=8192 THEN s.value ELSE NULL END AS dvr_settings,(s.value IS NOT NULL AND octet_length(s.value::text)<=8192) AS settings_supported FROM dispatcharr_channels_recording r JOIN dispatcharr_channels_channel c ON c.id=r.channel_id LEFT JOIN core_coresettings s ON s.key='dvr_settings' WHERE r.id=$1 LIMIT 1
prime_update: UPDATE dispatcharr_channels_recording SET custom_properties=$2 WHERE id=$1 AND custom_properties=$3
